journeyPage.label: About
journeyPage.title: Building software,
journeyPage.intro1: I'm Haboudi Boukari, a full-stack software engineer based in Parakou, Benin. I've been coding since 2021: first self-taught through freelance projects, then within companies. My work covers websites and online shops, business platforms, mobile apps and AI integration.
journeyPage.intro2: I'm completing my engineering degree in computer science, logistics and operations research at ENSGMM. It taught me to model a problem, optimise it and analyse it from data before writing the first line of code.
journeyPage.intro3: I'm open to freelance projects and software engineering roles. Alongside, I'm deepening my machine learning skills ahead of a master's in AI.
journeyPage.photoAlt: Portrait of Haboudi BOUKARI, arms crossed
journeyPage.visionLead: To become an AI research engineer, bringing two demands together:
journeyPage.visionLeadEm: a scientific contribution, and a system that works in the real world.
journeyPage.vision1: I plan a master's in AI, then a PhD, to deepen the mathematical foundations of machine learning, deep learning and optimisation. The fields that draw me: precision agriculture, satellite and multispectral image analysis, the environment, decision support and scientific simulation.
journeyPage.vision2: In the long run, I want to help build high-level African scientific and technological research, combining mathematical rigour, computing power and real impact.

agri.label: Digital agriculture
agri.title: Where data
agri.intro: A field I'm building up: drone mapping, geographic information systems and remote sensing, with the aim of applying artificial intelligence to them.
agri.ndviBody: A healthy plant absorbs red light and strongly reflects near infrared. A multispectral sensor measures both, and a simple calculation reveals the vigour of each plot, often before the eye can see a problem.
agri.nextIntro: Directions I plan to explore by combining these images with machine learning:
